{{Quote|Imperial forces claimed Lirra and surrounding systems over the weekend, driving out the Hutt dynasty which has ruled the planet for the past nine decades. The take-over was largely peaceful, and the Shando metro area is calm this coming.|A [[Colonial News Nets]] report|<ref name="GNN11" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lirra]] was '''subjugated''' in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. Three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the take-over, an undercover news investigation team discovered that the [[Jhank Shel]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] maintained over a million [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on [[Lirra]]. In response to the pressure of the public opinion, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Heedra]] of the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] declared Lirra a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] disaster. Heedra sent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to claim Lirra and surrounding [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. The subjugation was largely peaceful, with the Hutts merely lodging an official protest with [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="GNN12" /> The Jhank Shel members were soon driven back into [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Relief asisstance groups arrived on Lirra in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] following the planet's subjugation and it was expected that an Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] would be appointed to supervise the reorganization of the planet's infrastructure.<ref name="GNN12" />
